name: PlannerScene
description: Microsoft Planner board/charts scene with optional task-detail modal for project, incident, and sprint workflows.

activeTab.description: Highlighted tab. Defaults to Board for board variant and Charts for charts variant.

chartCards.description: Chart cards for variant=charts. Cards use type=donut or type=bar.

selectedTask.description: Task detail modal data when state=task-open: title, createdMeta, status, priority, startDate, dueDate, repeat, bucket, checklistItems, notes, showChat.

qualityNotes: Use PlannerScene when task ownership, status, buckets, or sprint execution are part of the story.
For board scenes, keep bucket count to 3-4 and card titles short enough to scan.
For task-open scenes, provide selectedTask only when the modal is the visual focus.
